messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sagai ho gayi hai, ab venue dhoondhna hai. Budget aur date fix karna hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Congratulations. Pehle teen cheez clear karo: guest count, city, aur mahina.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Guest count lagbhag 220 hoga, Mumbai mein, December 2026.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Mumbai mein December mein rates high hote hain. Teen shortlist bana raha hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pehla option Neelam Grand Banquet, Andheri East. 220 guests ke liye 4 lakh 80 hazaar.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: 4 lakh 80 thoda zyada lag raha hai. Koi terrace option hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, Sea Breeze Terrace, Bandra West. 220 guests, 6 lakh 20 hazaar, sunset view ke saath.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Bandra ghar se bahut door hai. Goregaon ya Malad mein kuch dekho.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Malad mein Shagun Farm House hai, outdoor lawn, 250 tak capacity, 3 lakh 90 hazaar.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Farm house interesting hai. Parking kitni hai wahan?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Shagun Farm House mein 80 cars ki parking hai, plus valet service included hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Catering ka kya scene hai? Outside caterer allowed hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Shagun mein in-house catering compulsory hai, 1450 rupees per plate, bahar wala allowed nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Neelam Grand mein outside caterer allowed hai kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Neelam Grand mein outside caterer allowed hai, lekin 25 hazaar ka levy lagega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sea Breeze Terrace mein catering ka rule kya hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sea Breeze mein sirf veg allowed hai, 1650 per plate, aur corkage 3000.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Papa ko farm house pasand aayega, unko bahar wala caterer chahiye.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: To phir Shagun Farm House out hai, kyunki wahan in-house hi chalega.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sahi. Ab Neelam Grand aur Sea Breeze mein se decide karna hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Neelam Grand ka hall 12000 square feet hai, Sea Breeze ka 7000.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: 22 December 2026 Neelam mein available hai kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Neelam Grand mein 22 December available hai, booking advance 1 lakh hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sea Breeze mein 22 December ka kya status hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sea Breeze mein 19 December khali hai, 22 pe already booked hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: To Neelam Grand final. Advance kal bhejti hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Theek hai, deejay aur decor wale ka contact bhi nikaal deta hoon.

questions.query: Sea Breeze Terrace ka corkage charge kitna hai?
Gaadi khadi karne ki jagah kitni milti hai?
Malad wale outdoor lawn ka rate kya hai?
22 December ko kaunsa venue khali hai aur advance kitna dena hai?
questions.answer_quote: Neelam Grand mein 22 December available hai, booking advance 1 lakh hai

questions.query: Papa bahar ka caterer chahte hain, to kaunsa venue out ho gaya?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Pune shift ho rahi hoon agle mahine. 2BHK dhoondhni hai Hinjewadi ke paas.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Budget aur move-in date batao, phir society shortlist karta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Budget 35 hazaar tak ki rent, move-in 15 April 2026.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Hinjewadi Phase 1 mein Blue Ridge society hai, 2BHK 32 hazaar, semi furnished.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Blue Ridge mein gym aur pool hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Blue Ridge mein gym hai, pool nahi. Club house hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Megapolis kaisa hai? Office se door hai kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Megapolis Hinjewadi Phase 3 mein hai, office se 4 kilometer, rent 38 hazaar.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: 38 thoda zyada hai. Wakad mein kuch option hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Wakad mein Kumar Selene hai, 2BHK 29 hazaar, fully furnished, 6th floor.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wakad se office kitna door padta hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Wakad se Hinjewadi tak 12 kilometer, peak hour mein 45 minute lagte hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Deposit kitna maang rahe hain Kumar Selene mein?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Kumar Selene mein deposit 2 mahine ka hai, 58 hazaar, refundable.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur Blue Ridge mein deposit ka kya rule hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Blue Ridge mein 1 lakh 50 hazaar deposit hai, jisme 50 hazaar non-refundable hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Non-refundable deposit bura hai. Wahi society mein koi doosra tower hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, wahi society mein 2BHK tower B mein 33 hazaar hai, deposit 99 hazaar refundable.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tower B theek hai. Maintenance kitna hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Tower B mein maintenance 4500 per month hai, parking alag se 1500.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kumar Selene mein pets allowed hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Kumar Selene mein pets allowed nahi hain, Blue Ridge mein allowed hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Meri billi hai, to Kumar Selene out. Blue Ridge Tower B final.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Good. Blue Ridge Tower B mein 22 April se possession mil sakta hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: 22 April thoda late hai, 15 April chahiye tha.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ek option hai: owner 10 April se de dega agar 6 mahine ka advance doge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, owner se baat kar lo. Brokerage kitni hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Brokerage ek mahine ka rent hai, 33 hazaar, sirf ek baar.

questions.query: Kumar Selene ka deposit kitna hai?
Ghar ke saath janwar rakhne ki permission kahan milegi?
questions.answer_quote: Kumar Selene mein pets allowed nahi hain

questions.query: Wakad wale flat se office kitni door hai?
Kumar Selene out hone ke baad kaunsa flat final hua aur deposit kitna hai?
Owner 6 mahine ka advance maange to move-in kab mil sakta hai?
questions.answer_quote: 10 April se de dega agar 6 mahine ka advance doge

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Trekking mein ghutne mein chot lag gayi. MRI report aa gayi hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Report mein kya likha hai? Ligament ka detail bhejo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: MRI mein ACL tear grade 2 likha hai, meniscus bhi thoda affected hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Grade 2 tear mein pehle physiotherapy try karte hain, 6 hafte ke liye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Physio kahan se karun? Ghar ke paas chahiye.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Andheri mein Dr. Meera Kulkarni hai, sports injury specialist, 12 saal ka experience.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Unki fees kitni hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Dr. Kulkarni 1800 per session leti hain, hafte mein teen session.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Surgery ka option kab dekha jata hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Agar 6 hafte mein range of motion 70 percent na aaye to arthroscopy karni padegi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Arthroscopy ka kharcha kitna hai Mumbai mein?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Mumbai mein ACL arthroscopy 1 lakh 80 hazaar se 2 lakh 40 hazaar tak.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Insurance cover karega kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Policy mein 24 mahine ka waiting period hai, tumhara 19 mahina poora hua hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: To abhi cover nahi hoga. Koi alternative hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, cashless network mein Kokilaben aur Hinduja dono hain, par waiting period issue hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Physio ke saath diet ka koi role hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Protein badhao, 1.6 gram per kilo body weight, vitamin D bhi check karao.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mera vitamin D 14 ng/ml tha last test mein.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: 14 ng/ml deficient hai, 60000 IU weekly 8 hafte ke liye le lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kya main dobara trekking kar sakti hoon?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Physio ke saath 4 mahine baad halki trekking allowed hogi, full 6 mahine.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Knee brace pehnna padega?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pehle 3 mahine brace zaroori hai, phir sirf trekking mein.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Dr. Kulkarni ka appointment kaise milega?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Unka clinic Monday, Wednesday, Friday khulta hai, 10 se 1 baje tak.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Next Wednesday appointment le lungi. Thanks.

questions.query: Dr. Kulkarni ka experience kitna hai?
Vitamin D ki kami ke liye kya lena chahiye?
Operation ka kharcha kitna hoga?
questions.answer_quote: 1 lakh 80 hazaar se 2 lakh 40 hazaar tak

questions.query: Physio se kaam na bane to kaunsa step lena padega?
questions.answer_quote: range of motion 70 percent na aaye

questions.query: Clinic kis din khulti hai?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: June mein Berlin conference hai. Schengen visa apply karna hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Germany se enter karogi to wahi se apply karna padega, kisi aur country se nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan Germany se, 8 June 2026 ko flight hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: VFS Global ka appointment lena padega, Mumbai center. Slot kam hote hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Appointment kitne din pehle book karna chahiye?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: 60 din pehle se slot khulte hain, peak season mein 45 din pehle book kar lo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Documents kya kya chahiye?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Passport, bank statement 6 mahine, invitation letter, aur travel insurance 30000 euro cover.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Bank statement mein minimum balance kitna dikhana hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Minimum 3 lakh balance chahiye, aur last 3 mahine ka average bhi dekhna.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mera bank statement mein 4 lakh 20 hazaar hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Theek hai, par 2 lakh ka lump sum deposit abhi mat daalo, suspicious lagta hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Conference invitation letter kaise milega?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Organizer se signed letter chahiye, jisme tumhara naam aur paper title ho.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mera paper title hai Neural Sparse Retrieval.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Wahi title letter mein likha hona chahiye. Aur hotel booking bhi chahiye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Hotel booking cancel karne ka charge lagega kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, free cancellation hotel booking chalega, par visa aane ke baad cancel mat karo.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Fingerprint kahan dena hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: VFS Mumbai center mein biometrics dena hai, Andheri East wala.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Fees kitni hai total?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Visa fee 90 euro hai, VFS service charge 2000 rupees, courier 700.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Visa kitne din mein aata hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Normally 15 working days, par June mein 20 tak lag sakte hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rejection ka chance kam karne ke liye kya karun?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Cover letter likho jisme conference ka purpose aur wapas aane ka plan clear ho.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, kal VFS ka slot dekh leti hoon.

Bank mein kitna paisa rakhna zaroori hai?
Invitation letter mein kya kya hona chahiye?
questions.answer_quote: jisme tumhara naam aur paper title ho
